onCartSyncError.description: Callback when cart sync fails during checkout. Use to display custom error messages, retry logic, or redirect users.

onSelectionChange.description: Callback when the shipping method selection changes. Use to update totals, validate selection, or trigger analytics.

ShippingMethods.description: The `ShippingMethods` container is designed to manage and display the selection of available shipping methods during the checkout process. You can configure it to handle the selection of shipping methods, display the available shipping methods, and manage the main slot for the shipping methods.

onRetry.description: Callback when the user clicks retry. Use to re-attempt the failed operation, show loading state, or redirect.

onServerError.description: Callback when a server error occurs. Use to log errors, trigger monitoring, or display custom error UI.

ServerError.description: The `ServerError` container is designed to handle and display server error messages during the checkout process. You can configure it to display an error message and handle click events.

onReferenceNumberChange.description: Callback when the purchase order reference number changes. Use to validate format, sync with external systems, or trigger analytics.

onReferenceNumberBlur.description: Callback when the reference number field loses focus. Use to validate on blur, persist the value, or trigger lookup.

PurchaseOrder.description: Displays purchase order for the Checkout drop-in.

onReferenceNumberChange.description: Callback when the payment reference number changes. Use to validate format, sync with external systems, or trigger analytics.

onReferenceNumberBlur.description: Callback when the reference number field loses focus. Use to validate on blur, persist the value, or trigger lookup.

PaymentOnAccount.description: Displays payment on account for the Checkout drop-in.

onCartSyncError.description: Callback when cart sync fails during checkout. Use to display custom error messages, retry logic, or redirect users.

onSelectionChange.description: Callback when the payment method selection changes. Use to show method-specific fields, update totals, or trigger analytics.

PaymentMethods.description: Use the `PaymentMethods` container to manage and display the available payment methods during the checkout process. Configuration options: - Set the payment method automatically or manually (starting without a selected payment method) - Show an icon beside of the label - Display or hide the label - Provide a specific handler to render the payment method

onCartProductsUpdate.description: Callback when cart products are updated after out-of-stock handling. Use to refresh the cart display, update totals, or trigger analytics.

OutOfStock.description: The `OutOfStock` container is designed to handle and display items in the shopping cart that are out of stock or have insufficient quantity. You can configure it to handle the removal of out-of-stock items and provide a route to the cart page.

onSignInClick.description: Callback when the user initiates sign-in. Use to show a custom login modal, redirect to sign-in page, or trigger analytics.

onSignOutClick.description: Callback when the user clicks sign out. Use to clear session state, redirect, or trigger analytics.

onCartSyncError.description: Callback when cart sync fails during checkout. Use to display custom error messages, retry logic, or redirect users.

onValidationError.description: Callback when form validation fails. Use to display custom error messages, focus invalid fields, or trigger analytics.

LoginForm.description: The `LoginForm` container handles user email input and validation within the checkout process.

onCartSyncError.description: Callback when cart sync fails during checkout. Use to display custom error messages, retry logic, or redirect users.

onChange.description: Callback when the address selection or form values change. Use for real-time validation, address lookup, or syncing with external systems.

BillToShippingAddress.description: The `BillToShippingAddress` container includes a checkbox that allows users to indicate if the billing address is the same as the shipping address. If unchecked, the billing address form will be displayed.

AddressValidation.description: The `AddressValidation` container displays a suggested shipping address (from a third-party verification service) alongside the entered address, allowing shoppers to choose between them.

EstimateShipping.description: The `EstimateShipping` container is designed to estimate and display shipping costs during the checkout process.

MergedCartBanner.description: Use the `MergedCartBanner` container to display a notification banner when items from an old cart are merged into the current cart.

PlaceOrder.description: The `PlaceOrder` container handles the final step in the checkout process, where the user confirms and places an order. Configure it to disable the button, perform validations before submitting the form, handle the place order action, and manage the content slot for the place order button.

TermsAndConditions.description: The `TermsAndConditions` container displays a checkbox that users must select to agree to the terms and conditions of the sale before confirming their purchase. During the checkout process, users must check all required agreements before placing an order. If an agreement is unchecked, a validation error appears when the user clicks the **Place Order** button.
